label: What is delivered
subgoals: Stream the layout with a single top cell
Map every layer to the foundry's layer and datatype numbers
Include the seal ring and the required marks

label: The signoff checks
subgoals: Run DRC, LVS, antenna, density and ERC on the final data
Document each waiver by rule and location
XOR the delivered stream against the signed-off database

label: After the handoff
subgoals: Expect foundry intake checks and possible rejection
Restrict late fixes to metal layers where spare cells allow
Use shuttles to share mask cost for small runs
